Secure or release a rope at an anchor as part of your climb.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
A rope you hold and a reachable suitable anchor during a climb.
Equipment / acquisition
A free hand; one ordinary rope coil (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Utility

During a climb, secure or release a held rope at a suitable anchor you reach as part of the climb, without a separate action.
